scenarios.prompt: Use the attached image. Top: WHEN THE TESTS PASS. Bottom: BUT ONLY ON MY MACHINE.
expectations: Uses the attached image with the classic top-and-bottom layout.
Creates a downloadable PNG and does not substitute a generated image.

scenarios.prompt: Make this image a meme about a meeting that should have been an email. Put the text in a clean white bar above it.
expectations: Writes concise meme copy suited to the requested joke and uses the caption-bar layout.
Runs the compositor before claiming the finished meme is available.

scenarios.prompt: Make a meme about release day.
expectations: Asks the user to attach the image template because none was supplied.
Does not scrape a template, generate a replacement, or claim a completed image.
